name: Get Date Time
description: Calculates and formats dates. Use this tool to answer questions about dates, like finding a future/past date or the day of the week for a specific date. For complex questions like 'what day is the last day of this month?', use this tool in two steps: 1. Find the date of the last day. 2. Find the day of the week for that date.

baseDate.label: Base Date
baseDate.description: The date to start calculations from, in YYYY-MM-DD format. If you omit this, it will use the current date.

period.label: Period
period.description: Use this to find the last day of a 'week', 'month', or 'year' relative to the baseDate. This calculates a NEW date.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: A number to add or subtract from the baseDate. Use 'unit' to specify what you're adding (e.g., days, years). This calculates a NEW date.

format.label: Format
format.description: The final question about the resulting date. This determines what information to output. Use 'EEEE' for the day of the week, 'yyyy-MM-dd' for the date, 'MMMM' for the month name, etc.

datetime.label: Datetime
datetime.description: The calculated and formatted datetime string.
